name: weakMean_norm_bound

name: weakMean_sub

name: weakMean_shift
stmt: lemma weakMean_shift (V : G →ᵇ H) (g : G) :     weakMean (V.compContinuous ⟨fun x => x+g, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩) = weakMean V := by

name: weakMean_map

name: periodSum_periodic

name: periodLift_mk
stmt: @[simp] lemma periodLift_mk (h : AF → H) (t : AF) :     periodLift h (QuotientAddGroup.mk t) = periodSum h t := rfl

name: period_term_zero
stmt: lemma period_term_zero {h : AF → H} {N : ℕ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     {t : AF} (ht0 : 0 ≤ (t : ℝ)) (ht1 : (t : ℝ) < 1) (k : ℤ)     (hk : k ∉ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)-2) ((N : ℤ)+2)) : h (t+k) = 0 := by

name: periodSum_norm_le
stmt: lemma periodSum_norm_le {h : AF → H} {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B) (t : AF) :     ‖periodSum h t‖ ≤ (Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)-2) ((N : ℤ)+2)).card * B := by

name: period_summable
stmt: lemma period_summable {h : AF → H} {N : ℕ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0) (t : AF) :     Summable (fun k : ℤ => h (t+k)) := by

name: periodSum_add
stmt: lemma periodSum_add {h j : AF → H} {N M : ℕ}     (hh : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hj : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → j t = 0) (t : AF) :     periodSum (h+j) t = periodSum h t + periodSum j t :=

name: periodSum_shift
stmt: lemma periodSum_shift (h : AF → H) (s t : AF) :     periodSum (fun x => h (x+s)) t = periodSum h (t+s) := by

name: periodBCF_mk
stmt: @[simp] lemma periodBCF_mk (h : AF → H) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B) (t : AF) :     periodBCF h hs hb (QuotientAddGroup.mk t) = periodSum h t := rfl

name: periodBCF_norm_le
stmt: lemma periodBCF_norm_le (h : AF → H) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :     ‖periodBCF h hs hb‖ ≤ (Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)-2) ((N : ℤ)+2)).card * B := by

name: integralReal_nonneg
stmt: lemma integralReal_nonneg (h : AF → ℝ) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B) (hp : ∀ t, 0 ≤ h t) : 0 ≤ integralReal h hs hb := by

name: integralReal_shift
stmt: lemma integralReal_shift (h : AF → ℝ) (s : AF) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B)     (hss : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h (t+s) = 0)     (hbs : ∀ t, ‖h (t+s)‖ ≤ C) :     integralReal (fun t => h (t+s)) hss hbs = integralReal h hs hb := by

name: integralReal_mono
stmt: lemma integralReal_mono (h j : AF → ℝ) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B)     (js : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → j t = 0)     (jb : ∀ t, ‖j t‖ ≤ C) (hle : ∀ t, h t ≤ j t) :     integralReal h hs hb ≤ integralReal j js jb := by

name: weakIntegral_pair
stmt: lemma weakIntegral_pair (h : AF → H) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ} (v : H)     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B)     (vs : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → inner ℝ v (h t) = 0)     (vb : ∀ t, ‖inner ℝ v (h t)‖ ≤ C) :     inner ℝ (weakIntegral h hs hb) v = integralReal (fun t => inner ℝ v (h t)) vs vb := by

name: weakIntegral_norm_bound
stmt: lemma weakIntegral_norm_bound (h : AF → H) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :     ‖weakIntegral h hs hb‖ ≤ (Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)-2) ((N : ℤ)+2)).card * B := by

name: weakIntegral_shift
stmt: lemma weakIntegral_shift (h : AF → H) (s : AF) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B)     (hss : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h (t+s) = 0)     (hbs : ∀ t, ‖h (t+s)‖ ≤ C) :     weakIntegral (fun t => h (t+s)) hss hbs = weakIntegral h hs hb := by

name: weakIntegral_sub
stmt: lemma weakIntegral_sub (h j : AF → H) {N M L : ℕ} {B C Q : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B)     (js : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → j t = 0)     (jb : ∀ t, ‖j t‖ ≤ C)     (ds : ∀ t : AF, (L : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t-j t = 0)     (db : ∀ t, ‖h t-j t‖ ≤ Q) :     weakIntegral (fun t => h t-j t) ds db = weakIntegral h hs hb - weakIntegral j js jb := by

name: weakIntegral_map
stmt: lemma weakIntegral_map {J : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup J] [InnerProductSpace ℝ J]     [CompleteSpace J] (L : H →L[ℝ] J) (h : AF → H) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B)     (js : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → L (h t) = 0)     (jb : ∀ t, ‖L (h t)‖ ≤ C) :     weakIntegral (fun t => L (h t)) js jb = L (weakIntegral h hs hb) := by

name: compact_local_summable
stmt: lemma compact_local_summable (f : C(ℝ, ℂ)) {N : ℕ}     (hs : ∀ t : ℝ, (N : ℝ) < |t| → f t = 0) (K : Compacts ℝ) :     Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖(f.comp (ContinuousMap.addRight k)).restrict K‖) := by

name: ordinaryPeriod_apply
stmt: lemma ordinaryPeriod_apply (f : C(ℝ, ℂ)) {N : ℕ}     (hs : ∀ t : ℝ, (N : ℝ) < |t| → f t = 0) (t : ℝ) :     ordinaryPeriod f (t : UnitAddCircle) = ∑' k : ℤ, f (t+k) := by

name: integralComplex_ordinary
stmt: theorem integralComplex_ordinary (f : C(ℝ, ℂ)) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : ℝ, (N : ℝ) < |t| → f t = 0) (hb : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ B) :     integralComplex (fun t : AF => f t) (fun t ht => hs t ht) (fun t => hb t) =       ∫ t : ℝ, f t := by

name: integralComplex_re
stmt: lemma integralComplex_re (h : AF → ℂ) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B)     (rs : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → (h t).re = 0)     (rb : ∀ t, ‖(h t).re‖ ≤ C) :     (integralComplex h hs hb).re = integralReal (fun t => (h t).re) rs rb := by

name: integralReal_ordinary
stmt: theorem integralReal_ordinary (f : C(ℝ, ℝ)) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : ℝ, (N : ℝ) < |t| → f t = 0) (hb : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ B) :     integralReal (fun t : AF => f t) (fun t ht => hs t ht) (fun t => hb t) =       ∫ t : ℝ, f t := by

name: weakIntegral_congr
stmt: lemma weakIntegral_congr (h j : AF → H) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → h t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, ‖h t‖ ≤ B)     (js : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → j t = 0)     (jb : ∀ t, ‖j t‖ ≤ C) (he : ∀ t, h t = j t) :     weakIntegral h hs hb = weakIntegral j js jb := by

name: shifted_support

name: smoothed_support
stmt: lemma smoothed_support (φ : AF → ℝ) {N : ℕ}     (hφ : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → φ t = 0) (v : H) :     ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → φ t • U t v = 0 := by

name: smoothed_bound

name: smoothed_translation_bound
stmt: theorem smoothed_translation_bound     (hu : ∀ s t v, U s (U t v) = U (s+t) v)     (φ : AF → ℝ) {N : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}     (hφ : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → φ t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, |φ t| ≤ B) (v : H) (s : AF) (hs : |(s : ℝ)| ≤ 1)     (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hd : ∀ t, |φ (t-s)-φ t| ≤ C) :     ‖U s (smoothedVector U φ hφ hb v) - smoothedVector U φ hφ hb v‖ ≤       (Finset.Icc (-((N+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)-2) (((N+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)+2)).card * (C * ‖v‖) := by

name: smoothed_tendsto
stmt: theorem smoothed_tendsto     (hu : ∀ s t v, U s (U t v) = U (s+t) v)     (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : UniformContinuous φ) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hφ : ∀ t : ℝ, (N : ℝ) < |t| → φ t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, |φ t| ≤ B) (v : H) :     Tendsto (fun s : AF => U s       (smoothedVector U (fun t => φ t) (fun t ht => hφ t ht) (fun t => hb t) v))       (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (smoothedVector U (fun t => φ t)         (fun t ht => hφ t ht) (fun t => hb t) v)) := by

name: wild_line_average_zero
stmt: theorem wild_line_average_zero (ν : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]     (hν : IsWild ν) {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0)     (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : UniformContinuous φ) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}     (hs : ∀ t : ℝ, (N : ℝ) < |t| → φ t = 0)     (hb : ∀ t, |φ t| ≤ B) :     InvariantMean.integralComplex       (fun t : F => (φ t : ℂ) * lineFourier ν a t)       (fun t ht => by rw [hs t ht, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul])       (fun t => by         rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]         exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (lineFourier_norm_le ν a t)).trans (hb t)) = 0 := by

name: linearFraction_polynomials

name: rational_functions_avoid

name: finite_hyperplanes_avoid

name: positive_mass_finite_centers
stmt: theorem positive_mass_finite_centers [StandardBorelSpace G]     [MeasurableSingletonClass G]     {K : Type*} [SMul K X]     (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ]     (d : X → G) (p : X → Y) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p)     (hi : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,       cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p (k • x), d (k • x)) =         cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p x, d x))     (hpos : 0 < differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) e.ordinary) :     ∃ a : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < a ∧       (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, cosetMass e (condDistrib d p μ) (p x, d x) = a) ∧       ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, ∃ S : Finset G, S.Nonempty ∧         (∀ b ∈ S, condDistrib d p μ y           ((e.center (probabilityKernel (condDistrib d p μ) y)) ⁻¹' {b}) = a) ∧         (∀ᵐ z ∂condDistrib d p μ y,           e.center (probabilityKernel (condDistrib d p μ) y) z ∈ S) ∧         (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) * a = 1 := by

name: finite_center_reduction

stmt: lemma conj_prod (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) : bmConj (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, bmConj (f i) := by

name: comp_prod
stmt: lemma comp_prod {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func Y)     (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) : comp (∏ i ∈ s, f i) q hq = ∏ i ∈ s, comp (f i) q hq := by

name: act_prod
stmt: lemma act_prod (g : G) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) :     act g (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, act g (f i) := by ext x; simp

name: act_zero
stmt: lemma act_zero (f : Func X) : act (0 : G) f = f := by ext x; simp

name: prod_orbit_correlation
stmt: lemma prod_orbit_correlation (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u h : G) :     (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i (u+h)) (f i)) * bmConj (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (f i)) =     ∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (act (φ i h) (f i) * bmConj (f i)) := by

name: prod_shift_erase
stmt: lemma prod_shift_erase (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (hj : j∈s)     (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u : G) :     (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (f i)) =     act (φ j u) (f j * ∏ i ∈ s.erase j, act ((φ i - φ j) u) (f i)) := by

name: l2_inner_mul
stmt: lemma l2_inner_mul (f h : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 μ f) (l2 μ (bmConj h)) =     (∫ x, (f*h) x ∂μ).re := by

name: correlation_product
stmt: lemma correlation_product (M : Amenable.Mean G) (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (hj : j∈s)     (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (h : G) :     M.correlation (Family.toL2 μ (∏ i ∈ s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)))       (Family.toL2 μ (∏ i ∈ s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i))) h =     inner ℝ (Family.avg μ M (∏ i ∈ s.erase j,       Family.orbit (φ i - φ j) (act (φ i h) (f i) * bmConj (f i))))       (l2 μ (bmConj (act (φ j h) (f j) * bmConj (f j)))) := by

name: norm_l2_conj
stmt: lemma norm_l2_conj (f : Func X) : ‖l2 μ (bmConj f)‖ = ‖l2 μ f‖ := by

name: inner_replace_project
stmt: lemma inner_replace_project (w h : Func X) (b : Func Y) (hw : w =ᵐ[μ] comp b q hq) :     inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj h)) =     inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj (project μ q hq h))) := by

name: inner_project_bound
stmt: lemma inner_project_bound (w h : Func X) (b : Func Y) (hw : w =ᵐ[μ] comp b q hq)     {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ C) :     |inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj h))| ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (project μ q hq h)‖ := by

name: avg_project_bound
stmt: lemma avg_project_bound (M : Amenable.Mean G) (W : Family G X) (h : Func X) (b : G → Func Y)     (hw : ∀ g, W g =ᵐ[μ] comp (b g) q hq) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ g x, ‖W g x‖ ≤ C) :     |inner ℝ (Family.avg μ M W) (l2 μ (bmConj h))| ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (project μ q hq h)‖ := by

name: prod_act_project_lift
stmt: lemma prod_act_project_lift (s : Finset ι) (ψ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u : G) :     (∏ i ∈ s, act (ψ i u) (project μ q hq (f i))) =ᵐ[μ]     comp (∏ i ∈ s, act (ψ i u) (conditional μ q (f i))) q hq := by

name: pairVanishing_of_ergodic
stmt: lemma pairVanishing_of_ergodic [ErgodicVAdd G (X×X) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)]     (M : Amenable.Mean G) : PairVanishing μ q hq M := by

name: Admissible.erase_diff
stmt: lemma Admissible.erase_diff {s : Finset ι} {φ : ι → G →+ G}     (ha : Admissible s φ) {j : ι} (hj : j∈s) :     Admissible (s.erase j) (fun i => φ i - φ j) := by

name: avg_product_zero_of_pair
stmt: theorem avg_product_zero_of_pair (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hpair : PairVanishing μ q hq M)     (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (ha : Admissible s φ)     (hc : ∃ j∈s, l2 μ (project μ q hq (f j)) = 0) :     Family.avg μ M (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)) = 0 := by

name: meanNorm_nonneg
stmt: lemma meanNorm_nonneg (F : Family G X) : 0 ≤ meanNorm μ M F :=

name: meanNorm_mono
stmt: lemma meanNorm_mono {F H : Family G X} (h : ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g)‖ ≤ ‖l2 μ (H g)‖) :     meanNorm μ M F ≤ meanNorm μ M H := M.mono _ _ h

name: meanNorm_congr
stmt: lemma meanNorm_congr {F H : Family G X} (h : ∀ g, F g =ᵐ[μ] H g) :     meanNorm μ M F = meanNorm μ M H := by

name: meanNorm_le
stmt: lemma meanNorm_le {F : Family G X} {C : ℝ} (h : ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g)‖ ≤ C) :     meanNorm μ M F ≤ C := by

name: meanNorm_zero
stmt: @[simp] lemma meanNorm_zero : meanNorm μ M (0 : Family G X) = 0 := by

name: meanNorm_add_le
stmt: lemma meanNorm_add_le (F H : Family G X) :     meanNorm μ M (F+H) ≤ meanNorm μ M F + meanNorm μ M H := by

name: meanNorm_neg
stmt: lemma meanNorm_neg (F : Family G X) : meanNorm μ M (-F) = meanNorm μ M F := by

name: meanNorm_sub_le
stmt: lemma meanNorm_sub_le (F H : Family G X) :     meanNorm μ M (F-H) ≤ meanNorm μ M F + meanNorm μ M H := by

name: meanNorm_mul_le
stmt: lemma meanNorm_mul_le (F H : Family G X) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ g x, ‖H g x‖ ≤ C) :     meanNorm μ M (F*H) ≤ C * meanNorm μ M F := by

name: meanNorm_const
stmt: lemma meanNorm_const (f : Func X) : meanNorm μ M (const f : Family G X) = ‖l2 μ f‖ := by

name: meanNorm_add_zero
stmt: lemma meanNorm_add_zero {F H : Family G X} (hF : meanNorm μ M F = 0) (hH : meanNorm μ M H = 0) :     meanNorm μ M (F+H) = 0 := by

name: meanNorm_mul_zero
stmt: lemma meanNorm_mul_zero {F H : Family G X} (hF : meanNorm μ M F = 0) :     meanNorm μ M (F*H) = 0 := by

name: meanNorm_sum_zero
stmt: lemma meanNorm_sum_zero {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Family G X)     (hF : ∀ i∈s, meanNorm μ M (F i) = 0) : meanNorm μ M (∑ i∈s, F i) = 0 := by

name: meanNorm_eq_zero_of_approx
stmt: lemma meanNorm_eq_zero_of_approx {F : Family G X}     (h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ H : Family G X, meanNorm μ M H = 0 ∧       ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g - H g)‖ ≤ ε) : meanNorm μ M F = 0 := by

name: conditional_apply
stmt: @[simp] lemma conditional_apply (F : Family G X) (g : G) :     conditional μ q F g = BoundedMeasurable.conditional μ q (F g) := rfl

name: conditional_add
stmt: lemma conditional_add (F H : Family G X) : conditional μ q (F+H) = conditional μ q F + conditional μ q H := by

name: conditional_sub
stmt: lemma conditional_sub (F H : Family G X) : conditional μ q (F-H) = conditional μ q F - conditional μ q H := by

name: covariance_apply
stmt: @[simp] lemma covariance_apply (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) :     covariance μ q φ v w g = conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w) -       conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w) := rfl

name: covariance_add_left
stmt: lemma covariance_add_left (φ : G →+ G) (v v' w : Func X) :     covariance μ q φ (v+v') w = covariance μ q φ v w + covariance μ q φ v' w := by

name: covariance_add_right
stmt: lemma covariance_add_right (φ : G →+ G) (v w w' : Func X) :     covariance μ q φ v (w+w') = covariance μ q φ v w + covariance μ q φ v w' := by

name: conditional_mul_project_act
stmt: lemma conditional_mul_project_act (g : G) (v w : Func X) :     conditional μ q (v*act g (project μ q hq w)) =ᵐ[μ.map q]       conditional μ q v * act g (conditional μ q w) := by

name: covariance_center
stmt: lemma covariance_center (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) :     covariance μ q φ v w g =ᵐ[μ.map q]       conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) (w-project μ q hq w)) := by

name: covariance_mean_zero
stmt: lemma covariance_mean_zero (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M)     (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (v w : Func X) :     Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) = 0 := by

name: inner_norm
stmt: lemma inner_norm (f : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : ‖inner t r x₀ f b‖ ≤ ‖f‖ :=

name: inner_add
stmt: lemma inner_add (f g : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : inner t r x₀ (f+g) b = inner t r x₀ f b + inner t r x₀ g b := by ext; rfl

name: inner_smul
stmt: lemma inner_smul (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : inner t r x₀ (c • f) b = c • inner t r x₀ f b := by ext; rfl

name: outer_add
stmt: lemma outer_add (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : outer t r x₀ (f+g) = outer t r x₀ f + outer t r x₀ g := by

name: outer_smul
stmt: lemma outer_smul (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : outer t r x₀ (c • f) = c • outer t r x₀ f := by

name: average_add
stmt: lemma average_add (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : average t r x₀ (f+g) = average t r x₀ f + average t r x₀ g := by

name: average_smul
stmt: lemma average_smul (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : average t r x₀ (c • f) = c * average t r x₀ f := by

name: average_mono
stmt: lemma average_mono {f g : C(X,ℝ)} (h : f ≤ g) : average t r x₀ f ≤ average t r x₀ g := by

name: average_const
stmt: lemma average_const (c : ℝ) : average t r x₀ (ContinuousMap.const X c) = c := by

name: average_translation
stmt: lemma average_translation (ht : ∀ a b x, t a (t b x) = t (a+b) x)     (φ : B → A → A) (hc : ∀ a b x, t a (r b x) = r b (t (φ b a) x))     (a : A) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (ha : Continuous (t a)) :     average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨t a,ha⟩) = average t r x₀ f := by

name: average_rotation
stmt: lemma average_rotation (hr : ∀ a b x, r a (r b x) = r (a+b) x)     (b : B) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (hb : Continuous (r b)) :     average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨r b,hb⟩) = average t r x₀ f := by

name: integral
stmt: lemma integral (f : C(X,ℝ)) : ∫ x, f x ∂measure t r x₀ = average t r x₀ f :=

name: preserving_of_average
stmt: lemma preserving_of_average (s : X ≃ₜ X)     (hav : ∀ f : C(X,ℝ), average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨s,s.continuous⟩) = average t r x₀ f) :     MeasurePreserving s (measure t r x₀) (measure t r x₀) := by

name: exists_terminal_factor
stmt: theorem exists_terminal_factor (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] :     ∃ p : X → OrbitSpace K, ∃ hp : Measurable p,       (∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) ∧ UniversalGood μ p ∧       ErgodicSMul K (X × X) (RelativeProduct.law μ p hp) := by
